subject: Consultancy partner marketplace evidence and co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Michelle Park <michelle@cloudedge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Consultancy partner marketplace intake — initial evidence pack

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As discussed, CloudEdge is ready to pursue a GCP and AWS marketplace listing alongside the co-sell badge. I've started a short evidence matrix attached that maps the common asks from AWS Partner Ops to what we can supply quickly. High-level asks we want to confirm now:

- SOC 2 report (type II) — CloudEdge has a current report but we need to confirm acceptable scope for marketplace (data processing boundary).
- Billing & metering integration details — how Redwood expects consumption reporting for co-sell attribution.
- Demo scripts + joint pitch deck (for AWS seller enablement).
- Commercial terms draft to check on private offers / pricing buckets.

Can you confirm which items Redwood will own (content or evidence) vs what CloudEdge must provide by 6/10? Ben — can your team take point for the metering spec and a short sample integration doc? Karthik — happy to loop you on the AWS technical evidence request if needed.

Attached: cloudedge_evidence_matrix.xlsx (work-in-progress).

Best,
Michelle
Michelle Park
Head of Partnerships, CloudEdge Consulting
michelle@cloudedge.com

--Attachment: cloudedge_evidence_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Park <michelle@cloudedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultancy partner marketplace intake — initial evidence pack

Hi Michelle — thanks for sending this over and for the clear matrix. We reviewed the attachment and sketched an internal split of ownership. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) SOC2 (scope): Redwood can provide a short note confirming what parts of our runtime and observability will be in-scope for any co-hosted demos. CloudEdge must provide its SOC2 PDF and a control mapping for marketplace intake. Target: CloudEdge uploads by 6/6.

2) Metering & billing: Ben will own the integration spec and a sample usage payload we expect for co-sell attribution. Ben — can you share a lightweight sample by EOD Friday (5/31)? We can feed that to AWS Partner Ops to accelerate entitlement mapping.

3) Demo & enablement kit: Redwood can draft a joint pitch deck template. CloudEdge to provide 2-3 customer use cases and short demo scripts (10–15m).

4) Commercial terms: For now we'll start with a commercial note (not final legal redlines) to share with AWS as an example private offer. I'll coordinate internally for a recommended pricing band.

I'll set up a 30-minute sync with AWS Partner Ops to walk through the evidence binder on Wednesday (6/5) — I'll invite the relevant folks.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances (Marketplace), Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

--Attachment: None

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Michelle Park <michelle@cloudedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultancy partner marketplace intake — initial evidence pack

Thanks — quick update on metering and a draft sample payload below.

Attached: mcp_readiness_summary.pdf (1p) — short summary of required telemetry and the fields AWS typically needs for co-sell attribution.

Sample usage event (JSON example included in the PDF):
{
  "customer_id": "C-123456",
  "resource": "redwood-inference:dedicated-gpu-pool",
  "sku": "rwd-dedicated-std-1",
  "usage_tokens": 1240,
  "start_time": "2029-05-01T00:00:00Z",
  "end_time": "2029-05-31T23:59:59Z",
  "partner_reference": "cloudedge-ORG-78"
}

Ben — proposed owners: Redwood emits usage samples and integrates with AWS metering; CloudEdge provides partner_reference mapping for their customers. If that works, I'll tidy the spec for AWS Partner Ops.

Ben Carter
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

--Attachment: mcp_readiness_summary.pdf (14KB)

From: AWS Partner Ops <aws-partner-ops@amazon.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Michelle Park <michelle@cloudedge.com>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS marketplace intake — next steps

Forwarding from the Marketplace intake queue — see notes below and a requested doc set. We need the following to proceed with co-sell enablement: 

- Final SOC2 PDF (latest date) + system boundary statement (PDF)
- Billing integration example + sample usage payload (the JSON Ben included is fine)
- Seller enablement deck (pptx or drive link)
- Private offer commercial note (plain text or PDF)

Milestone expectations: once we have the package we can open a co-sell enablement ticket and schedule a joint seller training within 2 weeks. Please confirm owners and upload documents to the AWS portal by 6/12.

On Wed, May 29, 2029 at 12:50 PM AWS Marketplace Intake <marketplace-intake@amazon.com> wrote:
> Request ID: AMI-99821
> Please attach SOC2, Billing Spec, and Seller Deck.
>
Appreciate the quick turnaround.

--AWS Partner Ops Team
aws-partner-ops@amazon.com
